correction.original_preregistration_phrase: Taking the maximum can only retain or widen the remaining-price distribution; it never makes the model more confident than the current volatility input.
correction.precise_statement: Taking the maximum retains or increases volatility. It usually moves the binary probability toward 0.5, but the Black-Scholes -sigma-squared-T-over-two term can move an exactly or nearly at-the-money probability slightly farther below 0.5.
correction.decision_impact: None. The candidate fails the preregistered minimum Brier-improvement gate and is rejected without retuning.

implementation_precision.initial_calculation: Used the standard-library error function for the normal CDF.
implementation_precision.final_calculation: Recomputed with an exact vectorization of the engine's Abramowitz-Stegun 7.1.26 implementation.

reproducibility_correction.issue: The first evidence write embedded the invocation-specific absolute or relative path used for repository-owned artifacts.
reproducibility_correction.resolution: Repository-owned paths are now serialized relative to the repository root, while the external archive directory remains explicit.
